root_cause: Direct LinkedIn/Composio publication ignored the existing scheduled_for timestamp; future time was enforced only by Buffer/customScheduled. Orchestrator also hardcoded +02:00 for Amsterdam after October DST change.
prevention_rule: The canonical social publisher must not perform prepublish/provider OAuth, claim, uniqueness reservation or publication before scheduled_for for either LinkedIn channel. Invalid timestamps fail closed. Amsterdam's offset is derived for each run_date; the same hourly canonical loop retries after due time.

evidence.note: Existing company post was provider LIVE_PROVEN but its time was before recorded scheduled_for.

outcome.target: Provider write at or after scheduled_for with next-day exact provider ID, no duplicate side effect, and correct wintertime offset.
